analysis: The only changed file is docs/developer/test.md. The patch rewrites the CI build-cache description (head lines ~142-153): only pushes to dev/master save a cache, and pull requests restore the base branch's entry and save nothing. It also adds a paragraph saying the MiMo audio gate (testNativeAudioRelease) runs only when the gate's inputs change (MIMO_AUDIO in scripts/ci-component-paths.py) and on every master push. The remaining supplied head text (lines 1847-2773) is unchanged documentation of test procedures. I found no changes to provider code, keys, attestation, App Attest authorization, the prefix-cache storage (T-041), the add-on socket (TB-012), the installer (TB-013) or coordinator protocol behavior. The documented CI change is arguably a security improvement: PR builds can no longer write cache entries, which reduces the risk of a cache-poisoning vector from PR-controlled builds. I could not verify that the workflow files actually implement this (e.g. cache save restricted to dev/master pushes), or that the MIMO_AUDIO path filter cannot be bypassed by changed inputs. The workflow YAML and scripts/ci-component-paths.py are outside the supplied evidence. Behavior and enforcement of the documented CI policy are therefore unverified, but the doc change alone is not a security regression. The test documentation mentions environment variables (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_TEST_PERSISTENT_KEY, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL) only in pre-existing unchanged text. No threat-model update is required for this PR.
